svg.title: Chelsea 3–0 PSG: the final against each team's earlier games
svg.desc: 2025 Club World Cup · 13 July final · six pre-final matches per team · whole-match descriptive comparison Sources: FIFA official match reports; Chelsea match report for score state. Chelsea led 3–0 at half-time. Selected case; no causal claim. Six earlier games per team; means are not opponent-adjusted or per 90. Different phase denominators retain FIFA definitions, without renormalizing. Whole-match shares cannot establish opening pressure or synchronized runs; a lead, conditions and substitutions can change later play.
